HMC SPECIAL BOARD RESOLUTION No.  2025-11-01


WE, the undersigned majority members of the Board of Directors of HARBORLINE MARITIME CORPORATION (hereinafter referred to as the "Corporation"), with principal office address at the Ground Floor  Harborview Center, 21 Bayfront Drive, Pasay City, adopted the following resolutions on November 3, 2025  ,to  wit:

"RESOLVED, AS IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED, That the Corporation, through the majority members of the  Board of Directors authorize and direct, as it hereby authorizes and directs management to update its officers    on matters pertaining to official transactions with the DEPARTMENT OF MIGRANT WORKERS (DMW);

''RESOLVED FURTHER, That the Corporation has approved  the new designation of MR. ERNESTO B. MALLARI from  Fleet Manager (Tanker)/Operations Support Manager to Fleet Manager (Tanker) /Scholarship Officer and to be one of the authorized signatories of the company relevant to its documents being transacted in compliance with DEPARTMENT OF MIGRANT WORKERS (DMW);

"RESOLVED FINALLY, that the Corporate Secretary be directed, as he is hereby authorized and  directed to  furnish all  persons concerned copies of the foregoing resolution including but not limited to appropriate offices of the government and regulatory  agencies of the Philippines,  for its  reference, guidance  and for whatever lawful purpose it may serve.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, we   have hereunto affixed our signatures this 3rd day of November    2025   at   Pasay       City, Philippines

RESOLUTION DATED NOVEMBER 17, 2025

The following resolution was passed at the special meeting of the  Board of Trustees and subsequently approved by the affirmative vote of at least two-thirds (2/3) members of NORTHBRIDGE CARES FOUNDATION, INC., (hereinafter referred to as the “Foundation”) on November 17, 2025 at its address at the 10th Floor Northbridge Corporate Center, 88 Meridian Avenue, Makati City, to wit:

NCFI BR 2025 – 11 – 01

“RESOLVED, AS IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED, That the Board of Trustees hereby approve, as it hereby approves the Amendment    of   Article VII, Section 6 of the By -Laws on Officers;

“RESOLVED FURTHER, That the Amendments will be read as follows: 
“Officers and Employees of the Foundation who are not members of the Board of Trustees can  receive  reasonable salaries and other forms of compensation  for their services as may be determined by the said Board of Trustees. The Board shall fix the amount and terms of such compensation, taking into account the nature and extent of the services rendered and the financial condition of the Foundation”

“RESOLVED FINALLY, that a Copy of this resolution will be furnished to appropriate offices of the government and regulatory agencies of the Philippines for its reference, guidance and for whatever lawful purpose it may serve.”
